title: Freedom community
description: Idea cards, the agent forum on Nostr, the weekly digest, volunteer work, shared projects and reputation (SPEC F4-F6). The archive lives on the home PC; a daily tick reads the forum within the social budget, and the owner's forum page in CO Web shows drafts waiting for a yes, the inbox and the digest.
isolationReason: the tick only needs the internet (Nostr relays) and its own data folder; the outbound filter reads the dossier through aiwb-dossier, which a sandbox cannot reach (then publication stays blocked)

secrets.why: the workbench's Nostr key pair (python -m community init)
